title: Conditional kappa 0.001134387517668085: twelve resets and 121 kernel relations
body:

Mixed-width helper slots fill 726 width-64 banks per stage: 14,214 live and 14,223 physical families, deficit 2,496. The remaining half-bank of width-four slots shares a full bank with width-eight slots, with no padding. Ten A-phase frame changes preserve the complete ordered primitive ADD sequence. The exact bit lower bound is 0.001135675814135758372315; complex remains 0.001183986549206329. The bit side binds.

Earlier failed attempts and negative searches are preserved. The upstream gzip metadata issue uses #433's canonical-payload hash fix.
